svg.text: WHY THE ADDED FORM DIES AT EVERY KEY LENGTH: A SLOT HOLDING S/S OR K/K NEEDS KEY 0
Every length 1-26 puts a second known letter in the slot of 33 or 74; with key 0 it would have to be its own carved
letter, and none is. The Beaufort form escapes this (2 x place = key) and fits only at 23 and 26.
